scope: Official documentation review of text-only, non-streaming OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions. Preset and synthetic coverage do not certify a live provider or every model. No price, account entitlement, regional availability or upstream model identity is asserted.

profiles.note: An arbitrary endpoint needs its own operator review and tests; the OpenAI contract alone cannot certify it.
Official base URL and model selection confirmed. JSON-mode behavior remains model-dependent. Separate bounded live evidence is recorded in model-evaluation-result.json.
max_completion_tokens includes reasoning tokens. JSON object mode is not schema conformance; strict local validation remains mandatory. Native Responses is outside this transport.
response_format depends on the selected model/upstream. PageSquire does not send model fallback lists, repair plugins or native hosted tools; inspect gateway routing separately.
OpenAI base URL confirmed; parameter and JSON support remain model-dependent. Responses is not this adapter.
JSON mode requires JSON instructions and an adequate output limit. Direct-service model aliases can change; do not infer that a gateway uses identical aliases or weights.
Use the workspace/region endpoint and a key issued for that region. Copy the account endpoint; no global URL or default model is assumed. Prompt mode avoids assuming universal JSON mode.
Standard Z.AI API key and endpoint confirmed. Coding Plan credentials/terms are not interchangeable with a public assistant API service.
Zhipu China base URL confirmed; select the service that issued the key. OpenAI compatibility has documented differences; no live account was tested.

Self-hosted /v1/chat/completions gateway, not a fixed public service. Its documented local HTTP defaults do not relax PageSquire HTTPS checks. Upstream fallback/routing must be reviewed by the gateway owner.

Google's OpenAI compatibility endpoint and structured parsing are documented. This is not the native Gemini/Interactions API. Check JSON-object support for the chosen model, or deliberately select prompt mode; it is not live-certified.
Chat Completions, max_tokens and response_format are documented; actual model/account support still needs live validation.
Base URL and chat/response_format mapping confirmed. Supported model IDs and structured-output availability are account/model choices, not a bundled fixed list.
OpenAI compatibility base URL confirmed. Model/deployment and JSON behavior need independent validation; no Fireworks account was exercised.
max_tokens is an alias of max_completion_tokens; never send both. JSON/model limits remain subject to the selected account/model.

Chat Completions is explicitly legacy. The existing legacy token profile is synthetic-tested, not evidence of universal reasoning-model compatibility. Responses-only/multi-agent variants are excluded.
